# `Q-12-13` — Listing Item Produced No Preview Content

> A listing item's rendered page has no first paragraph to derive a
> description from; the paragraph found before rendering is used
> instead.

## What this means

When a listed document has no description of its own (no `description:`
under `listing-item:`, no `description:`, no `abstract:`), the listing
derives one from the rendered page: its first paragraph. This warning
fires when Quarto found a first paragraph in the document *before*
rendering but cannot find one in the rendered output: the output has
only non-preview content (headings, raw HTML, ...), or the render did
not produce a file Quarto could inspect.

The item still appears in the listing, showing the paragraph Quarto
found before rendering.

A document with no paragraph at all, before or after rendering, is
routine and does not warn: its listing entry simply has no description.

## Why this happens

Common causes:

- **A custom render path** (filter, post-processor) removed or wrapped
  the paragraph the preview pass would have used.
- **The item's rendered output is missing** — for example, a partial
  render that did not render the listed document.

## How to fix

Add a `description:` to the item's front matter — an authored
description is used as written and skips the preview pass — or check
that the item's rendered page still has its opening paragraph.

## Related

- `Q-12-16` — sibling output unreadable: a related failure mode
  where the file existed but could not be read.
